Title: Incorrect error message returned when all parameter values are empty
Description: When all API parameter values are left empty in the Create Account request, the API returns an incorrect error message stating that the email already exists instead of providing a validation error indicating that the required values are missing or empty.
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Open https://automationexercise.com/api_list
2. Click on "API Testing" from the navbar.
3. Locate "API 11: "POST To Create/Register User Account".
4. Copy the API URL.
5. Open Postman.
6. Select the POST method.
7. Paste the copied API URL into the request URL field.
8. Click on "body".
9. Select "x-www-form-urlencoded"
10. Leave all parameter values empty while keeping the keys.
11. Click Send.
12. Observe the response code and message.
Expected Result: The API should reject the request and return an appropriate validation error for empty parameter values.
Actual Result: The API returned response code 400 and message "Email already exists!".

2. Click on "API Testing" from the navbar.

4. Copy the API URL.
5. Open Postman.
6. Select the POST method.
7. Paste the copied API URL into the request URL field.
8. Click on "body".
9. Select "x-www-form-urlencoded"

12. Observe the response code and message.

6. Select the POST method.
7. Paste the copied API URL into the request URL field.
8. Select "x-www-form-urlencoded" from the Body tab.
9. Enter all parameters with valid values.
10. Enter "hey" in the title parameter.
11. Click Send.

Title: API returns an incorrect error message when the email parameter is empty.
Description: When the email parameter is left empty in the login request, the API returns response code 404 with the message "User not found!" instead of returning a validation error indicating that the email field is required. The frontend displays "Please fill in this field."for the same scenario.
Steps to Reproduce:
. Open https://automationexercise.com/api_list
2. Click on "API Testing" from the navbar.
3. Locate "API 10: POST To Verify Login with invalid details".
4. Copy the API URL.
5. Open Postman.
6. Select the POST method.
7. Paste the copied API URL into the request URL field.("https://automationexercise.com/api/verifyLogin")
8. Click on the "Body" tab.
9. Select "x-www-form-urlencoded".
10. Enter "email" in the Key field and leave its Value field empty.
11. Enter "password" in the Key field and enter a valid password in its Value field.(1234)
12. Click Send.
13. Observe the response status code and message.
Expected Result: The API should reject the request and return an appropriate validation error indicating that the email is required.
Actual Result: The API returned response code 404 and the message "User not found!" instead of an email validation error.
